info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Reviews Management API
info.description: The Product Reviews Management API enables businesses to efficiently submit and manage customer reviews for specific products within their inventory. This API allows organizations to enhance their product offerings by collecting valuable customer feedback, facilitating product improvements, and boosting customer engagement. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms and retail systems that aim to improve customer experience through user-generated content. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure that customer insights are integrated into their product development and marketing strategies.
